name: Women's Corporate Service Dress: navy blazer, white shirt with tie tab, gray skirt (blank nametag)
size_basis: Outline, collar, lapels, armhole seams, front edge, hem, buttons, crest and lapel pin read off CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.15 (PDF page 89 at 8x; base-art/blazer-fig415-measure.js) at 66.37 px/in across, from the figure's 3 3/8 in nametag, and 67.76 px/in down (the figure is stretched 2.1 percent: its nametag is 3.67:1 against the 3.75:1 of Fig A6-3; the same figure measured against Fig 4.7a's coat, 2.4 percent). Blazer 24.79 in from collar to hem, 21.14 in across the sleeves, 15.97 in across the shoulders. No real garment was measured: the scale rests on the figure's nametag (the plate is not dimensioned in the regulation). The nametag is where 4.2.4.1.1.2 puts it on a blazer with no breast pocket, 1/2 in above the crest (Fig 4.15 draws no breast pocket; the Vanguard photo's welt was removed in LIVE12-ART 9). The hip flap pockets, sleeve buttons and the line above the cuff are not in the figure and are kept from Vanguard's product photo of the CAP women's blue blazer (CAP4200E), which the outline was traced from before LIVE12-ART 4. Chest geometry: the crest centre is 3.55 in from the centre line (a miniature rack 3 across, 2.06 in, centred on it has its inner edge 2.52 in out); the lapel edge ends at the break 7.20 in down, above the medal slot's top (7.43 in), so the lapel no longer crosses the rack.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons and polylines are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. nameplate_slot: its bottom edge 1/2 in above the crest's top, centred on the crest (4.2.4.1.1.2, no breast pocket); lapel_left / lapel_right: the lapel-foreground faces (wearer's left is +x); arm_seam_left / arm_seam_right: the armhole seam from the shoulder point down to the armpit (also drawn in group `seams`); shoulder_left / shoulder_right: the top edge of the shoulder from the neck to the sleeve head

figure_scale.source: CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.15, PDF page 89 at 8x; nametag 224 x 61 px against Fig A6-3's 3.75:1 plate

documented: navy single-breasted blazer, two or three buttons, notched lapels; pockets optional, no patch pockets (CAPR 39-1 4.2.4.1); Fig 4.15 draws three buttons
CAP Crest on the left breast pocket or in the same relative position (4.2.4.1.1.1)
nametag top edge aligned with the top of the left breast pocket, or 1/2 inch above the CAP Crest if the blazer has no pocket (4.2.4.1.1.2)
white aviator shirt or blouse with straight collar and blue inverted-V tie tab, the tab under the collar leaves (4.2.4.2-4.2.4.3)
medium gray slacks or straight/A-line skirt (4.2.4.4-4.2.4.5)
assumed: px-to-inch scale (the figure's nametag taken as 3 3/8 in wide; Fig A6-3's 3.75:1 for its height)
one outline for both halves: the two sides averaged, the body side below the armpit from the wearer's right (the left is under the sleeve; its hem corner is 0.32 in wider)
button diameter (0.72 in; the figure draws 0.77 in)
crest drawn 2.8 in tall (true size) centred under the nametag at the figure's crest height
skirt drawn as in the figure; slacks are a bottoms variant; 7.73 in of skirt below the hem (kept from the photo-built sheet)
hip flap pockets, sleeve buttons and the line above the cuff: not in Fig 4.15, kept from the Vanguard photo (flap height above the hem scaled by the blazer length)
skirt flare: 12 px of half-width per 100 px of height measured on Fig 4.15, applied from the coat side hem to the box bottom

skirt waist and waistband sizes (waist 3.5 in above the coat hem, 1.1 in narrower each side than the hem, 1.5 in waistband): the regulation gives no skirt dimension and the figure hides them under the coat
shirt placket button size (0.14 in radius) and spacing (2.3 in)

collar leaf and neckband shape and size: Fig 4.15 draws only the neckline and the tab (no collar), so the straight collar of 4.2.4.2.1 is built on it: leaves from the V's top corners to the neck over the tab corners, neckband between them
skirt gray #736f6c: the same medium gray as the aviator-shirt slacks and the men's blazer trousers (4.2.4.5, 4.2.5.1.5); the figure sample was #807d7b
skirt side shade (about 16 percent at the edges): the figure draws the skirt flat; no seam, pleat or vent because 4.2.4.5 forbids pleats and slits
